context:
Goal: every question that reaches you is checked for sense, not only shape.
Problem (risk): a chat question box gets a form check and a model review; a waiting-page item gets only the form check, so weak questions reach you unchecked.
Based on (read): hooks/call_judge.py runs question-judge on the chat box only; hooks/question_form.py checks both places for form.
Departs from: main (page writes get the form check only) — page writes also get the model review.

Asked and answered in chat with triage. Your answer, Nov 1 11:51 CST: "yes please add it that's incredibly important". Filed as roadmap step page-question-judge.

lastAnswer.note: yes please add it that's incredibly important
